A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ICE research. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting and reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original knowledge-editing experiments on four datasets, including Llama2 and GPT2-xl results, ablations, convergence analyses, and continual editing.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix D, including numerical comparisons, ablations, and generated-answer examples.

M1.justification: The stated objective changes from constrained KL optimization and an unweighted, target-conditioned decomposition in v1 Equations 5/7 to L_FT + lambda L_ICE in v2 Equation 6. This introduces an explicit balancing hyperparameter, but Algorithm 1 retains the same sampling and update steps; a changed experimental implementation is not established.

E1.justification: Both evaluate WikiDatarecent, ZsRE, WikiBio, and WikiDatacounterfact under the same knowledge-editing and continual-editing scenarios. v2 corrects scattered references to five datasets without changing actual coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain ROME, MEMIT, FT-L, and FT-M. The unedited reference curves also remain; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Reported splits, Llama2-7b-chat and GPT2-xl configurations, edited layers, metrics, 25-step budget, and learning rate remain unchanged. Continual evaluation still assesses each edit immediately without retesting earlier edits.

E4.justification: Both retain the dynamic-target/context ablations, temperature and sample-length/count analyses, convergence and token-probability analysis, and qualitative examples. v1 Appendix B largely becomes v2 Appendix D without additional analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. The tables retain point estimates, and v2 adds no repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Matched main, continual-editing, GPT2-xl, and ablation tables retain the same numerical results. The experimental plots and qualitative findings are also retained; figure rearrangement and table renumbering do not introduce new outcomes.

T1.justification: v1 Appendix A.3 and Equations 13–15, deriving the combined fine-tuning and target-conditioned contextual objective, are removed. The one-hot lemma, Observation 1 and its proof, and the locality/generalization assumptions remain.

C1.justification: Both claim that ICE learns toward a contextual distribution, dynamically refines its target, preserves model integrity, and supports continual editing. The shorter contribution list and corrected dataset count do not materially change these central claims.

C2.justification: v2 removes v1's limitation concerning unexploited internal model representations and its discussion of bias reinforcement. It also adds a catastrophic-forgetting interpretation of the retained continual-editing curves, without adding retention tests for earlier edits.

D1.justification: New Appendix C and Listing 1 disclose a prompt requesting five context statements, expanding v1's description of GPT-4-generated summaries. Existing implementation and hardware details remain. The listing references prompt before assigning it, limiting its executability.

R1.justification: v2 adds Brown et al. (2020) when defining in-context learning and elaborates the computational and scaling limitations of keeping updates in prompts. The existing editing literature and overall research positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and methodology are substantially rewritten, including a running example and clearer optimization subsections. The separate Analysis section becomes Section 3.5 Discussion, Algorithm 1 moves to Appendix B, and the appendices are reorganized.

P2.justification: The main text changes from two columns to one. The overview gains example annotations, the leading continual-editing figure is relocated and its panels rearranged, and Table 5 becomes side-by-side blocks. These constitute extensive display and layout changes.

improvement.justification: The clearer exposition and added context prompt improve accessibility, but v2 removes Appendix A.3's derivation connecting the sampler to its objective and introduces an unspecified lambda absent from the retained Algorithm 1. Removing the substantive limitations further weakens transparency. These technical reporting losses outweigh the presentation gains, while the empirical evidence remains unchanged.
